release_notes.headline_internal: Fix health field scope: worker_alive reports unavailable, not false, from workerless processes
release_notes.headline_external: Health reporting no longer claims a worker is down when the reporting process simply has no worker to observe
highlights: worker_alive and worker_process_alive are now a discriminated union carrying either an available value or an unavailable reason (not_host_capable), so a workerless process cannot emit a bare false that is indistinguishable from a real dead worker
The keying signal (workerRoleResolved) is set at worker-role resolution before the spawn branch, correctly classifying a non-lock-owning host under worker_singleton_enforce as host-capable
Reconciled duplicate TemporalHealthSnapshot declarations that had been hidden by as-unknown-as casts; removing the casts surfaced 9 masked consumer errors
A shared isWorkerAffirmativelyAlive predicate gives consumers and operator docs one vocabulary; unavailable cannot be coerced to falsy or truthy
Operator diagnostic matrix and field table migrated to the shipped vocabulary, including a new not_host_capable row
